failure.title: Recorded-run invariants expected a model identifier different from production persistence
failure.note: All three retained single-plan and weekly reports and six exact SQL transcripts show recordedSuccessfulRuns equal to zero while every other required programme, client, trace, evaluation, job, idempotency, retry, and canonical-week count is exact.
failure.diagnosis: The invariant SQL required agent_runs.model LIKE spotter-recorded%, but the production recorded gateway persists the exact identifier recorded/spotter-v1. Correct recorded rows were therefore excluded solely by the test predicate, making otherwise correct single-plan and weekly runs fail.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
